s1.ptxt: Place gear shift lever in “Neutral”, apply parking brake and block drive wheels.
Warm up engine to normal operating temperature.
Stop engine and turn off all electric switches.
With ignition “OFF”, connect SUZUKI scan tool to DLC (1).
Run engine at specified idle speed.
Check “MAP” under “Data List” mode on scan tool.

spec.title: Manifold absolute pressure specification (at sea level)
spec.ptxt: 20 to 55 kPa (0.2 to 0.6 kgf/cm2, 2.90 to 7.97 psi, 0.20 to 0.55 bar) at specified idle speed

s1.ptxt: After completing the check, set ignition “OFF” and disconnect SUZUKI scan tool from DLC.
